description:
Darksector

(not a game, but a mod for the game Starsector) is a mod that almost completely redesigns the visuals of celestial bodies in Starsector, aiming to make the game more realistic. This mod may be suitable for those who would like to see Starsector in a more realistic form rather than hand-drawn. The mod also provides new graphical improvements but does not change the generation of the universe. This is (probably) the last version of this mod, as I have done everything I wanted to do in this mod and would like to make a gameplay mod in the future. Since this mod was added to the Mods category rather than Modding, I decided to share the latest features.

All the new features available only after starting a new game!

. Also it is recommended to save and load after starting a new game.

Features

I won't describe all features of this mod here because there are so many of them. 8) I changed a lot of elements in the game, you can see the screenshots I provided.(AT THE BOTTOM OF THIS POST)
All I can say is that I completely changed the color palette of stars, backgrounds, and planets, trying to balance them.I also added features such as dynamic city lights, whose intensity depends on the planet's population, and new colored auroras, which are now generated around every habitable planet. In the new 1.3.5 update, I added 16 new backgrounds that are only displayed in systems with specific star types and changed the generation of planetary atmospheres—now the color and density of planetary atmospheres are also randomly selected from a prepared pool of colors, as was the case with another feature, aurora generation. Also, in version 1.3.5, the colors of the system are determined by the main star in the system(color override feature was originally in the game code, but was only available on specific systems).

Compatibility

This mod should be compatible with all mods.

Requirements

None!

Mod settings

!If you want to disable the new auroras that are now generated around every habitable planet, because they are game objects that change the characteristics of the ship and affect the gameplay, or simply you do not want to play with the new auroras, then you can disable them in the settings file from root folder of the mod:Darksector\settings\globalsettings - a file that has and will have different mod switches. You can also change the color of the cities there.(Changes for auroras applied every new game save,changes for city colors applied after loading save.)

Reshade

Reshade is a very important part of this mod for me, but for some it may not be—it may cause a decrease in performance or other problems. For my part, I haven't noticed any problems with Reshade and my preset. If you don't want to lose frames, I don't recommend installing Reshade, but with it, the mod takes on its full form (slight color correction and a cinematic grain effect).

Reshade Installation:

-1.Download the reshade installer from

https://www.reshade.me/

.

-2.Install it in .../starsector/jre/bin/java.exe , select the render engine OPENGL

-3.Uncheck all the checkboxes of downloadable effects.

-4.Download preset and throw them into /starsector/jre/bin/ with file replacement.

-Preset:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-0ASzRNC1l8e_ynRk8g8bKnKlVaKVNI/view?usp=sharing

-VirusTotal:

https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/YzhjNWE2ZDAxNGU4ZjlmZTk3YTYwYWZjMmVhNDQwNDM6MTc0Nzc4MzY0OA==

-5.Activate/disable effects:ctrl+home, settings panel:home.

Mod usage recommendations:

If you play with a large number of mods, always allocate more RAM in VMparams. Reshade is recommended for use with a small number of mods. Performance with this mod also drops with a large number of other mods, primarily due to the amount of available RAM and video memory on your PC. You can also install the lightweight version of the mod, which changes textures and does not add the new features listed in the "Features" section.

Performance Impact:

Reshade -

Very High

(especially in Hyperspace).

Textures - Medium (may be higher depending on your graphics card and available video memory – the more mods in the game, the less available video memory will be.)

New Mod Features - Low/Very Low, cityglow textures - Medium.

-New special texture for cities by me

- Clustered colonies.

(replacer for the basic Darksector cities texture):
